about_the_game:
Dive into Cube Foundry, a captivating incremental game where every click counts! Starting from a single cube, expand your production to create an industrial empire. Unlock powerful generators, purchase strategic upgrades, and ascend through Mastery levels to dominate the cube universe. Simple to learn, incredibly satisfying to master!

🏗️ From Humble Clicks to Intergalactic Industry

Your journey begins with a single, mysterious Central Cube. Each click generates valuable resources — the first sparks of your future empire. But this is just the beginning. Use your earnings to unlock a wide array of automated generators, each more advanced and efficient than the last. From the basic Mini Assembler to the awe-inspiring Dimensional Replicator, every machine helps you scale your cube production to astronomical levels.

⚙️ Optimize. Strategize. Multiply.

Don’t settle for the basics. In the Upgrades Panel, you'll find a rich variety of enhancements to fine-tune your operation:

  • Boost your click power

  • Supercharge specific generators

  • Apply global production multipliers
    Every choice matters — choose upgrades wisely to maximize your output and ROI.

🧠 Mastery: Prestige with Purpose

As your total cube production skyrockets, you'll begin to unlock the Mastery System — a long-term progression mechanic that rewards commitment with permanent bonuses. Each new level of mastery increases your efficiency, boosts automation, and accelerates your journey toward cube supremacy. How far can your engineering genius take you?
